scope: An explicit supplier_withholding fact references exactly one purchase_receipt_cash_allocation and one immutable policy version scoped to the selected tax claim account.
The amount is entered, positive, and currency-precision exact; there is no inferred rate, formula, or statutory interpretation.
The fact reduces supplier payable and purchase-invoice outstanding by the withholding amount and increases the selected tax-account payable by the same amount.
The fact has no cash, cash-allocation-capacity, or stock membership; actual cash remains solely the cash_out and purchase_receipt_cash_allocation.
One fact per allocation is enforced; source, party, entity, supplier, currency, tax-account, policy interval, and effective-date dimensions are validated.
The selected withholding tax claim may differ from the receipt's assessed input-tax claim; it must match the receipt's economic entity and currency and have a tax_account opponent.

mechanism.policy_version: READONLY tax_claim_account, policy_key, version, valid_from and valid_until fields; unique identity is (tax_claim_account, policy_key, version).
mechanism.withholding_fact: A user-managed fact references a typed purchase_receipt_cash_allocation and policy version. A unique allocation index prevents a second withholding fact for the same allocation.
tracked_dates: payment is a typed derived reference to allocation.source; payment_at depends on payment.effective_at.
mechanism.effects: One fact emits supplier payable -amount/net +amount, purchase invoice outstanding -amount, and selected tax claim payable +amount/net -amount at its explicit effective_at.
mechanism.capacities: The pre-existing purchase_receipt_cash_allocation is the only cash source allocation and amount 90 remains in cash_out.z_allocations. Supplier claim and purchase invoice outstanding guards reject aggregate over-settlement.

probe.output: Accounting H4b4a payer-side supplier withholding, shared-capacity guards, rollback, and cash/stock isolation passed
checks: A receipt with base 90 and assessed tax 10 opens supplier payable and purchase-invoice outstanding of 100, tax receivable of 10, and stock quantity 9.
Cash-out and receipt cash allocation of 90 leave treasury balance -90, source cash allocation capacity 90, supplier payable 10, and purchase-invoice outstanding 10 before withholding.

An explicit withholding of 10 leaves supplier payable 0 and invoice outstanding 0; the receipt's assessed-tax account retains receivable 10 and payable 0, while the distinct policy-selected withholding tax account receives payable 10.
Independent row oracles reconstruct supplier payable, invoice outstanding, tax payable, treasury cash and stock from source rows, allocations and withholding facts.

Zero, excess currency precision, duplicate allocation fact, amount 11 over-settlement, policy entity/currency mismatch, policy with a non-tax opponent, expired policy, pre-receipt/allocation date, invalid source type, and invalid cash-allocation party/entity/currency reject without changing the captured source/fact/root state.
Editing the immutable policy interval rejects; moving the allocation or receipt date past the fact date rejects atomically, confirming the declared causal date dependencies.
Withholding amount edit keeps the fact ID stable; removal leaves cash, cash allocation capacity and stock unchanged; re-addition at the same ID restores the posting.
Deleting the referenced allocation while a withholding fact exists rejects, preventing a stranded withholding fact.
probe.fixture_note: The main treasury account uses minimum_balance -100 to allow the specified isolated -90 cash-out without introducing a separate opening cash movement. Auxiliary funded treasury accounts exist only to exercise rejected source party/entity/currency allocations.

limits: This fixture records an explicitly entered withholding amount under a selected account-scoped version; it makes no rate or statutory interpretation claim.
One withholding fact per actual purchase_receipt_cash_allocation is supported; splits, multiple withholding reasons per allocation, reversals and remittance are later work.

The probe exercises the aggregate supplier payable and purchase invoice outstanding floors with an over-settlement attempt; it does not claim per-receipt settlement capacity beyond those shared roots.
The packet does not implement customer-withheld TDS, collector-side TCS, offsets, cash remittance, or production migration.
